# Cases not yet passing against juice 9.1.0 with Juice9(), with the reason.
# Format: <variant>/<fixture>  <reason>, or */<fixture> for every variant.
#
# Juice9() matches juice 9 exactly, divergences included, so this is empty.
# Ratcheting works as in juice-12.txt.
*/inline-seed/empty-rule  juice 9 rewrites the style attribute of every element a rule matches, even a rule with no declarations
*/cascade/repeated-simple-selectors  juice 9 (slick) counts one id per compound and each class once, so .c.c scores as .c
inline-pseudo-elements/pseudo-elements/not-last  juice 9 drops a rule with ::before or ::after anywhere but the last compound, which css-select rejects
